results.title: Definitions of SI Base Units | NIST

The mole, symbol mol, is the SI unit of amount of substance. One mole contains elementary entities. This number is the fixed numerical value of the Avogadro constant, NA, when expressed in the unit mol-1, and is called the Avogadro number. The amount of substance, symbol n, of a system is a measure of the number of specified elementary entities. An elementary entity may be an atom, a molecule, an ion, an electron, any other particle or specified group of particles. Note: CGPM in November 2018 with effect from 20 May 2019.
